လွှသမားများ လွှဆွဲနေကြသည်။
စပါးရွှေဝါ အားထားစရာ
လွှဲဖယ်၍ မနေပါ။
အားရပါးရ နွှဲပါဦး။
Our village is a place for fun
His body is drenched with water.
ဘယ်ပန်းတွေ မွှေးကြူနေသလဲ။  --- စံပယ်ပန်းများ
ကလေးတွေ ဘယ်လို ကစားကြသလဲ။  --- ပြေးလွှားကစားကြသည်
Who are sawing wood? --- The sawyers.
What is soaking the bodies of the sawyers? --- Sweat.
What should be done to the food? --- Reheat it.
What should be done to the edible fruits? --- Peel them.
What kind of joyful village is our forest village? --- A place to enjoy celebrations together.
What golden thing is reliable? --- Golden paddy.
Which flowers are fragrant? --- Jasmine flowers.
What is soaking his/her body? --- Water.
How should the fire be lit? --- Quickly.
What should be done near the fire? --- Keep moving away.
How is it at the sports event? --- Dripping with sweat.
How do the children play? --- Running around to play.
